preconditions.description: The number of words in the scroll must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(word) for word in words)
preconditions.description: Each word in the scroll must have a length of at least 1.
The total length of all words in the scroll must not exceed 20000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of ways to recover the original scroll modulo 10^9+7.
The number of ways to recover the original scroll must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: count == 0 if any(word < words[i-1] for i in range(1, len(words))) else True
postconditions.description: If any word is lexicographically smaller than the previous word, the count must be 0.
